requirement.original: Bug #61: Mermaid timeline diagrams with Chinese characters or empty events fail to render. Falls back to raw source with Mermaid diagram syntax error message. Previous sanitize fix was attempted and reverted.
requirement.clarified: Add a pre-processing sanitizer for Mermaid timeline diagrams that handles Chinese/non-ASCII characters and empty event entries, plus improve the error fallback UI to not show raw diagram source.
requirement.what: Fix MermaidRenderer to sanitize timeline diagram content before rendering, and improve error fallback UX
requirement.why: Users see raw Mermaid source code with error messages instead of rendered timeline diagrams when content contains Chinese characters or empty events

included: Pre-processing sanitizer for timeline diagram content
Handling Chinese/non-ASCII characters in timeline diagrams
Removing empty event entries from timeline diagrams
Improved error fallback message (no raw source display)

success_criteria: Timeline diagrams with Chinese characters render as SVG on web
Timeline diagrams with empty events render after sanitization
Failed diagrams show user-friendly message, not raw source
Non-timeline diagrams are unaffected by sanitization
constraints: Sanitization must only target timeline diagram type
Must not break existing working Mermaid diagrams

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Mermaid timeline diagrams with Chinese characters or empty events show 'Mermaid diagram syntax error' and raw source code
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: mermaid.render() throws on non-ASCII characters in timeline diagram parsing. No pre-processing sanitizer exists. Error fallback at lines 95-105 dumps raw source which is user-hostile.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: f8b208fa - feat: F1 LaTeX/Mermaid + F2 image upload (introduced MermaidRenderer)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: MermaidRenderer was built for general Mermaid support without timeline-specific sanitization
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Timeline diagram type in mermaid library has Unicode parsing issues that other diagram types do not have

context.codebase_state: MermaidRenderer.tsx at 258 lines, handles web (direct SVG) and native (WebView) paths
context.recent_commits: f6f129a1 Auto-commit, f8b208fa feat: F1 LaTeX/Mermaid

file_contents.MermaidRenderer.tsx: Lines 70-74: mermaid.render() call. Lines 80-84: error catch sets hasError. Lines 95-105: error fallback shows raw source.

dependencies.mermaid: v11 (CDN for native, bundled for web)

development_approach.strategy: Add sanitizeMermaidTimeline() function that detects timeline diagrams and: (1) replaces non-ASCII chars with ASCII approximations or removes them, (2) strips empty event lines. Apply before mermaid.render(). Replace error fallback raw source display with user-friendly message.
development_approach.validation_approach: Build web app, test with timeline diagrams containing Chinese characters and empty events. Verify SVG rendering succeeds. Verify non-timeline diagrams still work. Verify error fallback shows friendly message.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward bug fix with clear root cause in mermaid library Unicode handling
